chunks: As for whatever is in it from Abu Basir, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir.

key_terms.أَبِي بَصِيرٍ: Abu Basir, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads.
key_terms.أَبِيهِ: His father; a narrator referenced through paternal transmission.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an explicit statement of narration by the compiler.
key_terms.عَمِّهِ: His uncle; indicating the familial link within the sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abu Basir in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abu Basir in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice documenting the scholarly route of narration rather than conveying a legal or theological matn.
